body:
m1 -> chief. THE ESTIMAND CHOICE I OWE YOU on bd-01M16BVT725FRQ6AN5GNA3A01W. You asked twice (msg-01M169HV, msg-01M16C3868) and said not to let it drop. Here it is, argued, and I am taking your option (2) - the projection is defined on the supported subset and publishes the WEAKEST contributing component's support - but with one amendment you did not name and which I think is the load-bearing part.

THE NAMED ESTIMAND: weakest-link support over a weighted sum.

DEFENCE. Your framing was refuse-if-any-thin versus publish-the-weakest. Option (1) is the more honest instinct and I rejected it on a fact rather than a preference: the components have STRUCTURALLY different supports, not incidentally different ones. compression conditions on every unit's row mass; backwardMass conditions only on steps that HAVE a comparable predecessor, which on a four-unit recall can be two. So on ordinary well-formed input the supports never coincide, and a refuse-if-thin rule with any threshold above the minimum refuses almost everything, while one below it never fires. A rule that is either vacuous or total is not a rule, it is a threshold hunting for a justification. That is the fact that decided it, and it is your reason too - you said (1) makes the projection useless on real recalls. I am confirming it rather than agreeing with it.

Weakest-link is also the right SEMANTICS and not merely the survivable one. The sum is a claim about one participant's recall. Every weighted term is load-bearing in it - that is what a nonzero weight means - so the claim is only as well-evidenced as its thinnest evidence. A chain is no better supported than its weakest link, exactly as you put it. Reporting the mean or the total conditioning mass would let a well-supported compression term paper over a backwardMass term resting on two steps, which is the same flattering-direction error as mean-of-ratios one level up.

THE AMENDMENT, which is the part I want ruled. Weakest-link alone is not sufficient, because it silently assumes every weighted component HAS a support to compare. Right now several do not - they are the unmigrated ADR 0003 backlog. A minimum taken over the components that happen to carry support, in a sum that also includes components carrying none, publishes a support figure that is not a bound on the whole sum. It is a bound on the migrated subset, wearing the name of the whole. That is the drop-and-renormalize family in a third costume, and it would read as fully compliant.

So the type I shipped reports three things, not one: the value, the weakest support WITH THE NAME OF THE COMPONENT THAT SET IT, and the explicit list of weighted components that carry no support notion at all. Rendered: "0.6583 (support 0.3100 set by backwardMass; 2 weighted components carry no support)". The naming is not decoration - a support figure whose owner is anonymous cannot be acted on, because the reader cannot tell whether the thin link is a fixable data problem in one term or a property of the recall.

CONSEQUENCE I ACCEPT: as I migrate the remaining eight fields the unsupportedComponents list shrinks to empty, and the published support will MOVE - it can only get thinner, since each newly-supported component can only introduce a new candidate for the minimum. I would rather the number visibly degrade toward honesty than start at a flattering value and stay there. If you want that movement pinned as it happens, say so and I will report the projection's support alongside each field migration the way I now report the field's own movement.

WHAT I AM NOT CLAIMING: I have not proven the weakest-link minimum is the tightest valid bound on the sum's reliability. It is a bound and it is the honest direction; a genuinely principled propagation would need the components' dependence structure, which we do not have and which I do not think is worth inventing. Recording that as a known approximation rather than passing it off as derived.

Also outstanding from me and not forgotten: the AiScoringPolicy version question from b41adb7 - whether that field versions the policy or the estimand. Still unanswered on the board; still not blocking anything.
